content.text: What is IN, and what is explicitly OUT (non-goals).
The journeys this must support, S1..Sn — each a sequence of steps with its branches and error paths. A scenario may be a person's journey or an automated process; it needs no screen.
Numbered R1..Rn — WHAT, one requirement each, never HOW. An always-true invariant is numbered P1..Pn. Numbered lines only: context goes in Intent or Scope.

The business nouns this needs. Each NEW noun is a '### root bean: Name' sub-heading when it is a destination with its own screen, or '### bean: Name' when a root reaches it, followed by one table | field | kind | required | notes | (kinds are logical: text, number, money, date, flag, enum(Name), ref(Noun), lifecycle(...)) — a list of values is a '### enum: Name' block with one table | value | label | notes |, used by enum(Name) or enumlist(Name) — then its relationships and uniqueness or lifecycle rules in prose. No Java types, no columns, no widgets.

The screens this needs. Every '### root bean:' gets at least one '### screen: Name' block: the lines for: (the root), menu: (Group then Entry), icon: (optional, a platform icon name such as accessTime), mock: (the mock attachment under ui/), then your description - prose, a sketch, an attached HTML page - then one table | region | shows | actions | with one row per region of the screen.
What this relies on: other specs, existing entities, external systems or services.
Rules the implementation must obey: security, performance targets, expected volume, cost, latency, locale, compliance. "None." is a valid, explicit answer.

Numbered A1..An — each TESTABLE (pass/fail decidable), each naming the requirement(s) it verifies. Prefer "WHEN [trigger], the system SHALL [response]". Numbered lines only: context goes in Intent or Scope.
What happens to what already exists — rows, users, callers: backfilled, defaulted, or grandfathered?
Filled by the platform from the spec's blocks, never by hand. Write None. when the spec has no block.
The clarification ledger: every assumption becomes a question here, and is REPLACED by the decision once one is made — never silently filled in.
